13066.html:
13066 sakála 'with parts, divided' MaitrUp., 'whole' KātyŚr. [sa-², kalā́-¹]
    Pa. sakala- 'all, complete'; Aś. sakala- 'all, every'; Pk. sayala- 'all, whole', A. xayala, OB. saala, OG. sayala, °laü, Si. siyalu.

6648.html:
6648 dva 'two': m. dvaú (duvaú), dvā́ (duvā́), f.n. dvḗ (duvḗ) RV.
    Pa. dvē, duvē, Aś.shah. duvi, man. kāl. jau. duve, gir. dvo, dve, NiDoc. due, duvi, dui, du, dvi, Pk. dō, bē, duvē, Ap. di, bi, doṇṇi (after tiṇṇi s.v. tri-), Gy. eur. dui, rum. do, arm. lui, pal. dī́i, dī, Ḍ. dui, Ash. dū̆, dọ̈̄, Kt. dü, Wg. dṳ̄, dū̆, Pr. lṳ̄, Dm. Tir. dū (< duvā́ NTS xii 130), Paš. dō, dọ̈̄, dū, Niṅg. Shum. Woṭ. Gaw. dū (Gaw. dɔ́išī '200' poss. < duvḗ śatḗ, but more prob. with NOGaw 34 < *doš išī '20 X 10'), Kal. dū̆, Kho. ǰu (< *dyu < *dui? BelvalkarVol 91), Bshk. dūˋ, Tor. Kand. Mai. Sv. dū, Phal. dō, dū, Sh.gil. du (gen. dúinyo), gur. dūh, koh. jij. pales. dū, K. zᵃh (dat. dŏn), rām. dī˜h, pog. dīh, kash. zhe, ḍoḍ. dūī, S. ḇa (ḇeī 'both'), ḍ̠ū̃, L. ḍũ, (Ju.) ḍ̠ū̃, khet. ba, awāṇ. dō, P. do, dui, bhaṭ. dō, WPah.bhad. pāḍ. paṅ. khaś. dūī, bhal. dū, Ku. dui, dwī, N. A. B. dui, Or. dui, di, poet. beni, Bi. Mth. Bhoj. Aw.lakh. dui, H. do (donõ 'both'), Marw. do, OG. bi re-emphasized in G. bε, M. don, be (used in multiplication ← G.), Ko. dōni, OSi. do, de, Si. deka, Md. de.
    *du-², *dutīya-, *duvaṁdva-, *duvaka-, dvaṁdvá-, dvayá-, dvi-, dvíḥ, dvitī́ya-; dvācatvāriṁśat-, dvātriṁśat-, dvāpañcāśat-, *dvāmēla-, dvāviṁśati-, dvāṣaṣṭi-, dvā́saptati-, *dvāhasta-.
    Addenda: dva-: S.kcch. ḇa 'two', WPah.kṭg. (kc.) dui '2', kṭg. dunni, dunniε, dúnnhi, dúnnhiε 'the two, both'; Garh. dwi, Md. de (dui-satta '200' ← Ind.).
